integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained. Sign averaging is applied to the complete two-sided comparison, the scalar profile is optimized globally by strict concavity, and uniqueness is proved by an off-diagonal sign test. The numerical example is only a consistency check. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the real two-coordinate Luxemburg norm with 2<p<q<infinity. No claim is made for subquadratic or mixed-side exponent pairs, higher dimensions, or arbitrary coordinate Young functions. An equivalent convex-body approximation theorem under different terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: Unique optimal circle for superquadratic mixed-power Musielak--Orlicz planes
